root_cause: The public checkout path required Stripe secrets in Netlify that were never supplied, so /afsluiten stayed disabled. Payments now run through Mollie via a Supabase Edge Function that reads its key from Vault.
prevention: Netlify holds no payment-provider secret: it only calls bg-mollie-checkout with the Supabase service token it already uses. Readiness reports the edge function state; tests assert the fail-closed behaviour and that no provider key is sent from Netlify.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until a Mollie test payment completes end to end through the website

limitations: Depends on the bg-mollie-checkout edge function from the Mollie edge PR
